'''Tura Sanga''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] member of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. Sanga was a famous maker of [[shikkar]]s&mdash;[[Glass/Legends|glass]] weapons utilized by members of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Tribe. By [[44 ABY]], one of Sanga's shikkars had come to be in the personal collection of the [[Sith Saber]] [[Gavar Khai]]. In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Khai passed the weapon on to his daughter, [[Vestara Khai|Vestara]].

==Biography==
Tura Sanga was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]]<ref name="Note">In ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]'', it is stated that shikkars were crafted from the Force; thus, as a shikkar-maker, Sanga must have been able to utilize the Force</ref> born on the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. A member of the planet's [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], Sanga used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to mold [[Glass/Legends|glass]] into intricate dagger-like weapons known as [[shikkar]]s. Sanga's style in crafting shikkars was unique, and Sanga's work became very well known among members of the Sith Tribe.<ref name="Allies" />

One shikkar made by Sanga was eventually kept in the personal collection of the [[Sith Saber]] [[Gavar Khai]]. In [[44 ABY]], Khai passed the shikkar on to his daughter, [[Vestara Khai|Vestara]], who hoped that she would be able to use the weapon to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] or Skywalker's son, [[Ben Skywalker|Ben]], during their [[Mission to the Maw|upcoming mission]]. Vestara instantly identified the shikkar as one designed by Sanga, recognizing the distinctive style in which the weapon had been made.<ref name="Allies" />

==Powers and abilities==
As a shikkar-maker,<ref name="Allies" /> Tura Sanga was gifted with sensitivity to the Force. Sanga was able to use the Force<ref name="Note" /> to shape glass into shikkars&mdash;weapons of deceptive frailty that were considered to be honorable by the Lost Tribe of Sith. Sanga was proficient at the process, eventually becoming one of the most famous shikkar-makers in the Sith Tribe on Kesh.<ref name="Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tura Sanga was mentioned in the fifth installment of the nine-part [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series, ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]'', written by [[Christie Golden]] and released in [[2010]].<ref name="Allies" />
